EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
(Notice under Section 7)

Ref No.: WEG/LAN/LI/ACQ/48-III. I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act. No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following Land/servitude which is required for the public purpose of the reconstruction of Polwathumodara bridge.

Description of the Land to be acquired: Lands depicted in the survey plan bearing No. P.P.MR/2644, situated in the villages of Pelana North, Pelana South and Polwathumodara in Grama Niladari Divisions of Pelana North, Pelana South and Polwathumodara in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Weligama, Matara District. This acquisition is made for the reconstruction of Polwathumodara bridge.
